snippet.title: Table Top Racing World Tour -  Tropical Ice Pack DLC
snippet.description:
BIG news today! We've just launched our new DLC on both PlayStation​ Store and #Steam for Table Top Racing: World Tour! 

Check out the new 'Tropical Ice Pack' featuring 2 new locations, 8 new race circuits, 2 new gameplay modes, 3 full championships, 16 new Special Events AND 6 new Trophies - on the store now! 

Full details are available from here - http://ow.ly/3nwF303NeAH

The Tropical Ice Pack includes new tracks, ‘Life’s a Beach’ featuring a tricky and technical circuit built around two areas of an amazing Brazilian juice bar, and ‘Yellowsnow Piste’, a luxury la-dee-da ski lodge in a European Alpine location including a hot-tub and random snowball fights that occasionally derail your plans for victory…

Get it now from the direct links below:

Tropical Ice Pack DLC on PlayStation Store EU - https://goo.gl/XRE3MO

Tropical Ice Pack DLC on PlayStation Store US - http://goo.gl/cQ4P2D

Tropical Ice Pack DLC on Steam - http://store.steampowered.com/app/512940/
